description: This file defines the AppRunnerClient class in the Aws\AppRunner namespace. It provides method signatures (via PHPDoc) for interacting with the AWS App Runner service, including methods for creating, deleting, describing, and listing resources related to App Runner, as well as associating or disassociating custom domains, managing auto-scaling configurations, VPC connectors, and other related operations. The class extends AwsClient and serves as a client interface to the AWS SDK for PHP.

classes.name: AppRunnerClient
